content_zh:
武朝。
荒州，余侯府。
“这疯子什么时候回来的？”
“他居然还活着，当年他在镇荒塔中失去道种，被追杀逃入蛮荒，按理说他应该死了才对……”
“余烬你闯下弥天大祸，让整个余氏蒙羞，还有什么脸回来侯府！？”
大殿之内，一众余氏子弟议论纷纷，所有的目光皆是落在场中那孤零零站着的古怪少年身上。
少年浑身裹在一件黑袍里，在大殿中心席地而坐，双膝上放着一柄长刀，青铜刀鞘老旧生锈，刀上系着一根绳子，另一头系着一条黄皮老狗。
黄皮老狗伏在地上，吐舌摇尾，而少年主人低垂着眼眸，昏昏入睡，对于周围的敌意，充耳不闻。
“余烬……”大殿内香炉焚起清烟，高处坐着十数位府中议事堂的长辈，其中一位身穿深红宫装，青丝高盘的美艳妇人看着少年，朱唇轻启，“你消失了三年，侯府上下早已当你死去，真是没想到还能见到你回来。”
听见美艳妇人的声音，名为余烬的少年终于是缓缓睁开眼眸，平静地看了前者片刻，突然笑道：“柳凤，你都没死呢，我又怎么会死！？”
大殿内，瞬息针落可闻，那些原本骂骂咧咧的余氏子弟，悉数闭嘴，眼中尽是有着一抹不可置信。
那宫装美妇名为柳凤，正是当今余侯的正室夫人，侯府的主母！
这番大逆不道的话语，大概也就是少年这种当年闯下滔天大祸的疯子才会敢说出口吧？
余氏长辈里有人轻轻咳嗽了一声，“余烬，莫要说得太过分，你终究是晚辈，还是侯爷的血脉，按理说你与小蝶，喊夫人一声娘亲也不过分……”
少年抬起头，冷冷地将话打断，“老东西，你放什么臭屁！我娘亲当年失踪于大荒，这女人才成为了侯府主母，我还有妹妹跟这女人可没有半点关系！”
“你！”那位长辈被怼的哑口无言，看着那少年，十六七岁的年纪，脸上明明还有着少许稚嫩，可此时那双黑眸却深邃得让人心中泛冷！
少年仰望着坐在高处那些余氏的权势长辈，声音不大却传遍整个大殿，“娘亲出身剑山，是剑山首席，掌握倾天剑经，更是内定的下一代剑主，却莫名在大荒内失踪，这件事我一直想不明白！”
“余烬，你什么意思？”
“你娘亲的失踪，跟我余氏可没半点关系！”
“没错，当年剑山因为忤逆武朝皇室，龙骑将追至大荒，那场大战过后，谁都知道她早已……”

“都闭嘴，你们疯了吗！？不要在这里谈这种禁忌话题！！”
“余烬，莫要在这里胡搅蛮缠，当年若不是念在你是余侯子嗣，余氏根本不会让你存在！！”
高位上那些余氏长辈似乎同时想到什么，悉数缄默不语，不少人都冷冷地看向余烬，似乎很不满他提起旧事。
少年名为余烬，当今荒州余侯的第三子，因为娘亲出身的剑山被武朝定为逆贼，这种禁忌出身让整个余氏蒙羞，兄妹二人也因此在余府受过无数白眼和排挤。
“你娘亲早已死了，当年的事情更是盖棺定论，你回来就是为了说这些毫无意义的事情？”柳凤神色平淡，居高临下地看着大殿中心的少年。“若是这样，我劝你更应该想想，三年前你闯下大祸一走了之，今日是否要为当初犯下的过错，付出代价？”
“错……”少年余烬低头看向手中长刀，“我有什么错？！”
“既然你记性不好，那我就提醒你一下。“柳凤看着少年，”你偷取府令，擅入镇荒塔，荒塔是关押着从整个大荒捕捉来的绝世凶兽与妖物的禁地，如有任何纰漏，荒州都将会万劫不复，这是其一！
content_en:
Wu Dynasty.
Huangzhou, Yuhou Mansion.
"When did this madman come back?"
"He is actually still alive. He lost his Taoist seed in the Desolation Tower and was chased and fled into the wilderness. Logically speaking, he should be dead..."
"You Yan have caused a huge disaster and brought shame to the entire Yu family. Why do you have the nerve to come back to the Marquis Mansion!?"
In the main hall, all the disciples of the Yu family were talking about each other, and all eyes fell on the strange young man standing alone in the hall.
The young man was wrapped in a black robe and sat on the ground in the center of the hall. There was a long knife on his knees. The bronze scabbard was old and rusty. There was a rope tied to the knife, and an old yellow-skinned dog was tied to the other end.
The yellow-skinned old dog lay on the ground, sticking out its tongue and wagging its tail, while the young owner lowered his eyes and fell asleep, turning a deaf ear to the hostility around him.
"Embers..." The incense burner in the main hall lit up the clear smoke. There were more than a dozen elders from the mansion's council sitting high up. One of them, a beautiful woman wearing a deep red palace dress and high black hair, looked at the young man, her red lips parted slightly, "You have disappeared for three years, and everyone in the Marquis Mansion has long considered you dead. I really didn't expect to see you come back."
Hearing the voice of the beautiful woman, the young man named Yu Yan finally slowly opened his eyes, looked at the former calmly for a moment, and suddenly smiled: "Liu Feng, you are not dead, how can I die!?"
In the main hall, a pin drop could be heard in an instant. The disciples of the Yu family who had been cursing all shut up, with a hint of disbelief in their eyes.
The beautiful woman in palace attire is named Liu Feng. She is the current wife of Marquis Yu and the mistress of the Marquis' mansion!
These rebellious words must only be spoken by a lunatic like the young man who caused huge disasters back then, right?
Someone among the elders of the Yu family coughed slightly, "Yu Yan, don't go too far. You are a junior after all, and you are still a descendant of the Marquis. Logically speaking, it is not too much for you and Xiaodie to call Madam "Mother"..."
The young man raised his head and interrupted coldly, "Old man, what the hell are you farting! My mother disappeared in the wilderness, and this woman became the mistress of the Hou Mansion. My sister and I have nothing to do with this woman!"
"You!" The elder was speechless and looked at the young man. He was sixteen or seventeen years old, and his face was obviously still a little immature, but at this time, his black eyes were so deep that it made people feel cold!
The young man looked up at the powerful elders of the Yu family who were sitting high up, and his voice was not loud but it spread throughout the entire hall, "My mother was born in Jianshan, she is the chief of Jianshan, she masters the Qingtian Sword Scripture, and she is the appointed next generation sword master, but she disappeared inexplicably in the wilderness. I have never been able to understand this matter!"
"Ember, what do you mean?"
"Your mother's disappearance has nothing to do with my Yu family!"
"That's right, because Jianshan disobeyed the Wu Dynasty royal family, the Dragon Riders chased her to the wilderness. After that battle, everyone knew that she had already..."
"Shut up, are you crazy!? Don't talk about such taboo topics here!!"
"Yi Yan, don't mess around here. If I hadn't thought that you were the heir of Marquis Yu, the Yu family would never have let you exist!!"
The elders of the Yu family in high positions seemed to have thought of something at the same time, and they all remained silent. Many people looked at Yu Yan coldly, as if they were dissatisfied with him for bringing up old things.
The boy's name is Yu Yan, the third son of Marquis Yu of Huangzhou. Because his mother was born in Jianshan, he was designated as a traitor by the Wu Dynasty. This taboo origin brought shame to the entire Yu family. For this reason, the two brothers and sisters suffered countless looks and ostracism in Yu Mansion.
"Your mother has died a long time ago, and what happened back then has been finalized. Why did you come back to say these meaningless things?" Liu Feng looked calmly and looked down at the young man in the center of the hall. "If this is the case, I advise you to think about it. Three years ago, you caused a big disaster and ran away. Do you have to pay the price for the mistakes you made today?"
"Wrong..." The young man Yi Yan lowered his head and looked at the long knife in his hand, "What's wrong with me?"? ! "
"Since you have a bad memory, let me remind you. "Liu Feng looked at the young man, "You stole the government order and entered the Desolate Tower without permission. The Desolate Tower is a forbidden place where the peerless ferocious beasts and monsters captured from the entire wilderness are imprisoned. If there is any mistake, the Desolate State will be destroyed. This is one of them!
